","voice_new_ui.mp3":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","voice_new_witness.mp3":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,"});
const STORAGE_KEY='eal_production_2026_'+GAME.id+'_v1';
function asset(name){return EMBED_ASSETS[name] || name;}
function initialState(){return {view:'map',chapter:0,unlockedChapter:0,currentScene:GAME.entryScenes[0],mapPos:{x:GAME.scenes[GAME.entryScenes[0]].mapX,y:GAME.scenes[GAME.entryScenes[0]].mapY},dest:null,visited:{[GAME.scenes[GAME.entryScenes[0]].id]:true},docs:{},clues:{},npcChoices:{},microOpen:{},puzzleSolved:{},puzzleState:{},draft:{},writing:{},cites:{},decisions:{},logs:[],stats:JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(GAME.stats)),music:false,finished:false,showFrames:true};}
let S=load(); let currentTab='objective'; let anim=null;
function load(){try{return Object.assign(initialState(), JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY)||'{}'));}catch(e){return initialState();}}
function persist(){try{localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY,JSON.stringify(S));}catch(e){}}
function esc(s){return String(s??'').replace(/[&<>\"]/g,m=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[m]));}
function pad(n){return String(n+1).padStart(2,'0');}
function toast(msg){const t=document.getElementById('toast');t.textContent=msg;t.classList.add('show');clearTimeout(t._t);t._t=setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('show'),3200);} 
function statChange(delta={}){for(const k in delta){S.stats[k]=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,(S.stats[k]||0)+delta[k]));}persist();}
function docKey(ch,id){return ch+'::'+id;}
function chapterGate(ch){return {docs:readCount(ch)>=GAME.chapters[ch].docs.length, field:clueCount(ch)>=1&&talkCount(ch)>=1, micro:!!S.microOpen[ch], puzzle:!!S.puzzleSolved[ch], writing:!!S.writing[ch], decision:!!S.decisions[ch]};}
function readCount(ch){return GAME.chapters[ch].docs.filter(d=>S.docs[docKey(ch,d.id)]).length;}
function clueCount(ch){return GAME.chapterScenes[ch].filter(i=>S.clues[GAME.scenes[i].id]).length;}
function talkCount(ch){return GAME.chapterScenes[ch].filter(i=>S.npcChoices[GAME.scenes[i].id]!==undefined).length;}
function objectiveText(){if(S.finished)return 'Case closed. Review your path, export your report, or restart to test a different route.'; const C=GAME.chapters[S.chapter],g=chapterGate(S.chapter); if(!g.docs||!g.field)return C.objective; if(!g.micro)return 'Use the field clue code to unlock the evidence board.'; if(!g.puzzle)return 'Solve the chapter puzzle to prove you can interpret the chapter evidence.'; if(!g.writing)return 'Write an evidence-based response using chapter language and cite two sources.'; if(!g.decision)return 'Make a consequential decision. Your choice will change the route and the ending.'; return C.cliff;}
function chapterStatusLine(ch){const g=chapterGate(ch); return [g.docs?'sources ✓':'sources',g.field?'field ✓':'field',g.micro?'code ✓':'code',g.puzzle?'puzzle ✓':'puzzle',g.writing?'write ✓':'write',g.decision?'choice ✓':'choice'].join(' · ');}
function currentSceneObj(){return GAME.scenes[S.currentScene];}
function sceneUnlocked(i){return GAME.scenes[i].chapter<=S.unlockedChapter;}
function render(){const app=document.getElementById('app'); app.innerHTML=`<header><div class="brand"><div class="eyebrow">NEXT-GENERATION · FINAL DRAFT EDITION</div><h1>${esc(GAME.title)}</h1><p>${esc(GAME.subtitle)} · ${esc(MAPCFG.worldLabel)}</p></div><div class="toptools"><button class="btn slim ${S.view==='map'?'gold':'ghost'}" onclick="switchView('map')">WORLD MAP</button><button class="btn slim ${S.view==='scene'?'gold':'ghost'}" onclick="switchView('scene')">CURRENT SCENE</button><button class="btn slim ghost" onclick="openAudioPanel()" aria-label="Sound settings">${(S.music||S.effects)?'♫ AUDIO ON':'♫ AUDIO OFF'}</button><button class="btn slim ghost" onclick="saveFile()">EXPORT SAVE</button><button class="btn slim ghost" onclick="loadFile()">IMPORT SAVE</button><button class="btn slim danger" onclick="resetGame()">RESET</button></div></header><div class="stats">${Object.entries(GAME.statLabels).map(([k,v])=>`<div class="stat"><label><span>${esc(v)}</span><strong>${S.stats[k]}</strong></label><div class="bar"><i style="width:${S.stats[k]}%"></i></div></div>`).join('')}</div><div class="main"><div class="leftcol"><div class="panel viewport">${S.view==='map'?renderMap():renderScene()}</div></div><div class="rightcol"><div class="panel"><div class="eyebrow">CHAPTER ${pad(S.chapter)} / 04</div><h3>${esc(GAME.chapters[S.chapter].name)}</h3><p class="muted">${esc(objectiveText())}</p><div class="tabs">${renderTabs()}</div><div class="pane">${renderPane()}</div></div></div></div>`; syncAudio(); if(S.view==='map')startMapAnim(); else stopMapAnim();}
function renderTabs(){const tabs=[['objective','MISSION'],['archive','ARCHIVE'],['gate','FIELD LOCK'],['puzzle','PUZZLE'],['write','WRITE'],['decide','DECIDE'],['log','LOG']]; return tabs.map(([id,l])=>`<button class="tab ${currentTab===id?'active':''}" onclick="currentTab='${id}';render()">${l}</button>`).join('');}
function sceneOverlay(sc){const n=(sc.name+' '+sc.desc).toLowerCase(); return `${/record|monitor|editing|research|control/.test(n)?'<div class="scan"></div>':''}${/river|bridge|pump|water|canal/.test(n)?'<div class="water"></div>':''}<div class="fog"></div>${/tower|hall|booth|newsroom/.test(n)?'<div class="flicker"></div>':''}<div class="drift"></div><div class="vignette"></div>`;}
function renderMap(){const active=GAME.scenes[S.currentScene]; const nodes=GAME.scenes.map((sc,i)=>`<button class="node ${sceneUnlocked(i)?'unlocked':'locked'} ${i===S.currentScene?'current':''}" style="left:${sc.mapX}%;top:${sc.mapY}%" onclick="goNode(${i})" ${sceneUnlocked(i)?'':'disabled'}><span class="chapterBadge">CH ${pad(sc.chapter)}</span><div>${i+1}</div><span>${esc(sc.name)}</span></button>`).join(''); const lines=MAPCFG.edges.map(([a,b])=>`<line x1="${GAME.scenes[a].mapX}" y1="${GAME.scenes[a].mapY}" x2="${GAME.scenes[b].mapX}" y2="${GAME.scenes[b].mapY}" stroke="rgba(172,233,244,.35)" stroke-width="0.45" stroke-dasharray="1.2 1"></line>`).join(''); return `<div class="mapBack"></div><div class="viewportTop"><div class="titleCard"><div class="eyebrow">WORLD EXPLORATION</div><h2>${esc(MAPCFG.worldLabel)}</h2><p>${esc(MAPCFG.worldPrompt)}</p></div><div class="infoCard"><div class="eyebrow">CURRENT OBJECTIVE</div><p>${esc(objectiveText())}</p></div></div><div class="mapWrap" style="background-image:url('${asset(GAME.id+'_world_map.webp')}')"><div class="mapOverlay"></div><svg class="mapLines" viewBox="0 0 100 100" preserveAspectRatio="none">${lines}</svg>${nodes}<div id="avatar" class="avatar" style="left:${S.mapPos.x}%;top:${S.mapPos.y}%"></div><div class="arrival" style="left:${active.mapX}%;top:calc(${active.mapY}% + 24px)"><h4>${esc(active.name)}</h4><small>${chapterStatusLine(active.chapter)}</small><div style="margin-top:8px;display:flex;gap:8px"><button class="btn slim gold" onclick="enterCurrent()">EXPLORE</button><button class="btn slim ghost" onclick="jumpToChapter(${active.chapter})">CHAPTER</button></div></div></div><div class="mapFooter"><div>${Array.from({length:4},(_,i)=>`<span class="chip ${i===S.chapter?'active':''}">CH ${pad(i)} · ${esc(GAME.chapters[i].name)}</span>`).join('')}</div><div class="infoCard" style="max-width:420px"><div class="eyebrow">AT LOCATION</div><p><b>${esc(active.name)}</b></p><p>${esc(active.question)}</p><button class="btn slim gold" onclick="enterCurrent()">ENTER LOCATION →</button></div></div>`;}
function renderScene(){const sc=currentSceneObj(), chapter=sc.chapter, docs=GAME.chapters[chapter].docs; const hs=sc.hotspots.map(h=>{const photo=h.kind==='document'?evidenceProp(S.currentScene,2):h.kind==='clue'?evidenceProp(S.currentScene,1):asset(GAME.id+'_npc_'+S.currentScene+'.png');return `<button class="hotspot ${seenHotspot(sc,h)?'seen':''}" style="left:${h.x}%;top:${h.y}%" onclick="openHotspot('${h.id}')"><img class="hotThumb" src="${photo}" alt=""><span>${esc(h.label)}</span><span class="pulseRing"></span></button>`}).join(''); return `<div class="sceneBg" style="background-image:url('${asset(sc.art)}')"></div>${sceneOverlay(sc)}<div class="viewportTop"><div class="titleCard"><div class="eyebrow">LOCATION ${S.currentScene+1} / 10</div><h2>${esc(sc.name)}</h2><p>${esc(sc.desc)}</p></div><div class="infoCard"><div class="eyebrow">INVESTIGATION QUESTION</div><p>${esc(sc.question)}</p><div class="chip">${readCount(chapter)}/${docs.length} primary sources</div><div class="chip">${clueCount(chapter)} field clues</div><div class="chip">${talkCount(chapter)} witness talks</div></div></div>${hs}<div class="sceneBottom"><div class="chip active">CH ${pad(chapter)} · ${esc(GAME.chapters[chapter].where)}</div><div class="titleCard" style="max-width:430px"><div class="eyebrow">THEME</div><p>${esc(sc.theme)}</p><div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:8px"><button class="btn slim ghost" onclick="switchView('map')">← BACK TO MAP</button><button class="btn slim gold" onclick="currentTab='archive';render()">OPEN CHAPTER SOURCES</button></div></div></div>`;}
function seenHotspot(sc,h){if(h.kind==='document')return !!S.docs[docKey(sc.chapter,h.id)]; if(h.kind==='clue')return !!S.clues[sc.id]; if(h.kind==='person')return S.npcChoices[sc.id]!==undefined; return false;}
function renderPane(){switch(currentTab){case 'objective':return objectiveHTML();case 'archive':return archiveHTML();case 'gate':return gateHTML();case 'puzzle':return puzzleHTML();case 'write':return writeHTML();case 'decide':return decideHTML();default:return logHTML();}}
function objectiveHTML(){const C=GAME.chapters[S.chapter]; return `<div class="callout"><div class="eyebrow">CURRENT CHAPTER</div><h3>${esc(C.name)}</h3><p>${esc(C.intro)}</p></div><div class="list">${GAME.chapterScenes[S.chapter].map(i=>{const sc=GAME.scenes[i]; return `<div class="entry"><div class="meta">LOCATION ${i+1}</div><h4>${esc(sc.name)}</h4><p>${esc(sc.question)}</p><button class="btn slim ${S.currentScene===i?'gold':'ghost'}" onclick="travelToScene(${i})">${S.currentScene===i?'CURRENT LOCATION':'TRAVEL HERE'}</button></div>`}).join('')}</div><div class="callout"><div class="eyebrow">PROGRESS</div><p>${chapterStatusLine(S.chapter)}</p><div class="soft">Read all chapter documents, find at least one field clue, speak to at least one witness, unlock the field code, solve the puzzle, write with evidence, and make a consequential decision.</div></div>`;}
function archiveHTML(){const ch=S.chapter, C=GAME.chapters[ch]; const sources=C.docs.map(d=>`<div class="entry"><div class="meta">${esc(d.kind)} · ${esc(d.date)}</div><h4>${esc(d.label)}</h4><p>${esc(d.takeaway)}</p><button class="btn slim ${S.docs[docKey(ch,d.id)]?'gold':'ghost'}" onclick="openDocument(${ch},'${d.id}')">${S.docs[docKey(ch,d.id)]?'REOPEN':'OPEN SOURCE'}</button></div>`).join(''); const field=GAME.chapterScenes[ch].map(i=>{const sc=GAME.scenes[i]; return `<div class="entry"><div class="meta">FIELD EVIDENCE</div><h4>${esc(sc.name)}</h4><p>${esc(sc.clue)}</p><div class="soft">Witness: ${esc(sc.npc)}</div><div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:8px"><button class="btn slim ${S.clues[sc.id]?'gold':'ghost'}" onclick="openClue(${i})">${S.clues[sc.id]?'REOPEN CLUE':'VIEW CLUE'}</button><button class="btn slim ${S.npcChoices[sc.id]!==undefined?'gold':'ghost'}" onclick="openNpc(${i})">${S.npcChoices[sc.id]!==undefined?'REOPEN WITNESS':'QUESTION WITNESS'}</button></div></div>`}).join(''); return `<div class="callout"><div class="eyebrow">PRIMARY SOURCES</div><p>These are the written texts students must read and cite.</p></div><div class="list">${sources}</div><div class="callout"><div class="eyebrow">FIELD EVIDENCE</div><p>Animated evidence and witness interviews add immersion and consequences.</p></div><div class="list">${field}</div>`;}
function gateHTML(){const ch=S.chapter,G=GAME.microGates[ch],g=chapterGate(ch),val=S.puzzleState['code_'+ch]||''; return `<div class="callout"><div class="eyebrow">FIELD LOCK</div><h3>${esc(G.title)}</h3><p>${esc(G.hint)}</p></div><div class="entry"><div class="meta">UNLOCK REQUIREMENTS</div><p>${g.docs?'✓':'○'} All ${GAME.chapters[ch].docs.length} primary sources read</p><p>${g.field?'✓':'○'} At least one field clue and one witness interaction</p>${(!g.docs||!g.field)?'<p class="soft">Explore the world first. The lock only opens after you have enough evidence.</p>':`<input class="textin" value="${esc(val)}" placeholder="Enter code or word" oninput="S.puzzleState['code_'+${ch}]=this.value;persist()"><div style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:10px"><button class="btn gold" onclick="unlockCode()">UNLOCK</button><button class="btn ghost" onclick="openModal('<div class=\'eyebrow\'>FIELD LOCK HINT</div><h3>${esc(G.title)}</h3><p>${esc(G.hint)}</p><p class=\'soft\'>The answer comes directly from the chapter evidence.</p>','Hint')">HINT</button></div>${S.microOpen[ch]?'<div class="chip active" style="margin-top:10px">FIELD LOCK OPEN ✓</div>':''}`}</div>`;}
function unlockCode(){const ch=S.chapter,G=GAME.microGates[ch],g=chapterGate(ch); if(!g.docs||!g.field){toast('Explore and gather more evidence first.');return;} const val=String(S.puzzleState['code_'+ch]||'').trim().toLowerCase(); if(val===String(G.answer).trim().toLowerCase()){S.microOpen[ch]=true;persist();currentTab='puzzle';render();toast('Field lock open. Puzzle board unlocked.');} else toast('That code does not match the evidence.');}
function ensurePuzzleState(ch){if(!S.puzzleState[ch]){const P=GAME.chapters[ch].puzzle; if(P.type==='sort'||P.type==='choice')S.puzzleState[ch]=Array(P.items.length).fill(''); else if(P.type==='order')S.puzzleState[ch]={pool:[...P.items],picked:[]}; else if(P.type==='budget')S.puzzleState[ch]=[];} persist();}
function puzzleHTML(){const ch=S.chapter,P=GAME.chapters[ch].puzzle,g=chapterGate(ch); if(!g.micro)return `<div class="callout"><div class="eyebrow">LOCKED</div><p>Use the field lock first. The puzzle only opens after the chapter evidence has been read, checked, and unlocked.</p></div>`; ensurePuzzleState(ch); if(S.puzzleSolved[ch])return `<div class="callout"><div class="eyebrow">PUZZLE CLEARED ✓</div><h3>${esc(P.title)}</h3><p>${esc(P.instruction)}</p><button class="btn gold" onclick="currentTab='write';render()">GO TO WRITING →</button></div>`; let inner=''; if(P.type==='sort'){inner=P.items.map((it,idx)=>`<div class="quizrow"><p><b>${idx+1}.</b> ${esc(it[0])}</p><select onchange="setPuzzleValue(${ch},${idx},this.value)"><option value="">Choose…</option>${P.options.map(o=>`<option ${(S.puzzleState[ch][idx]||'')===o?'selected':''}>${esc(o)}</option>`).join('')}</select></div>`).join('');} else if(P.type==='choice'){inner=P.items.map((it,idx)=>`<div class="quizrow"><p><b>${idx+1}.</b> ${esc(it[0])}</p><select onchange="setPuzzleValue(${ch},${idx},this.value)"><option value="">Choose…</option>${it[1].map(o=>`<option ${(S.puzzleState[ch][idx]||'')===o?'selected':''}>${esc(o)}</option>`).join('')}</select></div>`).join('');} else if(P.type==='order'){const st=S.puzzleState[ch]; inner=`<div class="callout"><p>${esc(P.instruction)}</p><div class="list">${st.picked.map((x,idx)=>`<div class="picked">${idx+1}. ${esc(x)} <button class="btn slim ghost" onclick="removeStep(${ch},${idx})">remove</button></div>`).join('')||'<div class="soft">Click steps below to build the sequence.</div>'}</div><div class="frames" style="margin-top:10px">${st.pool.map((x,idx)=>`<button class="btn slim ghost" style="margin:4px" onclick="addStep(${ch},${idx})">${esc(x)}</button>`).join('')}</div><div style="margin-top:10px"><button class="btn slim ghost" onclick="resetOrder(${ch})">Reset order</button></div></div>`;} else if(P.type==='budget'){const st=S.puzzleState[ch]||[]; inner=P.items.map(it=>`<button class="chip ${st.includes(it.id)?'active':''}" onclick="toggleBudget('${it.id}')">${st.includes(it.id)?'✓ ':''}${esc(it.text)}</button>`).join('')+`<p class="soft" style="margin-top:10px">Choose exactly two repairs. There is no single correct answer, but your choice will shape the ending.</p>`;} return `<div class="callout"><div class="eyebrow">EVIDENCE PUZZLE</div><h3>${esc(P.title)}</h3><p>${esc(P.instruction)}</p></div>${inner}<div style="margin-top:12px;display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap"><button class="btn gold" onclick="checkPuzzle()">SUBMIT PUZZLE</button>${P.type==='budget'?'<button class="btn ghost" onclick="clearBudget()">CLEAR</button>':''}</div>`;}
function setPuzzleValue(ch,idx,val){ensurePuzzleState(ch);S.puzzleState[ch][idx]=val;persist();}
function addStep(ch,idx){const st=S.puzzleState[ch];st.picked.push(st.pool.splice(idx,1)[0]);persist();render();}
function removeStep(ch,idx){const st=S.puzzleState[ch];st.pool.push(st.picked.splice(idx,1)[0]);persist();render();}
function resetOrder(ch){const P=GAME.chapters[ch].puzzle;S.puzzleState[ch]={pool:[...P.items],picked:[]};persist();render();}
function toggleBudget(id){const ch=S.chapter;let st=S.puzzleState[ch]||[]; st=st.includes(id)?st.filter(x=>x!==id):st.length<2?[...st,id]:st; S.puzzleState[ch]=st;persist();render();}
function clearBudget(){S.puzzleState[S.chapter]=[];persist();render();}
function checkPuzzle(){const ch=S.chapter,P=GAME.chapters[ch].puzzle; let ok=false; if(P.type==='sort')ok=P.items.every((it,idx)=>(S.puzzleState[ch][idx]||'')===it[1]); else if(P.type==='choice')ok=P.items.every((it,idx)=>(S.puzzleState[ch][idx]||'')===it[2]); else if(P.type==='order')ok=JSON.stringify(S.puzzleState[ch].picked)===JSON.stringify(P.answer); else if(P.type==='budget')ok=(S.puzzleState[ch]||[]).length===2; if(ok){S.puzzleSolved[ch]=true;persist();currentTab='write';render();toast('Puzzle solved. The writing task is now unlocked.');} else toast('Some evidence is still misread. Check the sources again.');}
function wordCount(s){return String(s||'').trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;}
function writeHTML(){const ch=S.chapter,C=GAME.chapters[ch],W=C.writing,g=chapterGate(ch),draft=S.draft[ch]||'',cites=S.cites[ch]||[]; if(!g.puzzle)return `<div class="callout"><div class="eyebrow">LOCKED</div><p>Complete the puzzle first. The writing task is the chapter action that moves the story forward.</p></div>`; return `<div class="callout"><div class="eyebrow">WRITING CHECKPOINT</div><h3>${esc(W.title)}</h3><p>${esc(W.prompt)}</p><div class="chip">${wordCount(draft)} words</div><div class="chip">minimum ${W.min}</div></div>${S.showFrames?`<div class="frames"><b>Useful frames</b><ul>${W.frames.map(f=>`<li>${esc(f)}</li>`).join('')}</ul><div style="margin-top:8px"><b>Academic vocabulary</b><div>${W.words.map(w=>`<span class="chip">${esc(w)}</span>`).join('')}</div></div></div>`:''}<textarea id="writer" oninput="S.draft[${ch}]=this.value;persist();renderCountsOnly()">${esc(draft)}</textarea><div style="margin-top:10px"><div class="eyebrow">SELECT AT LEAST TWO SOURCES TO CITE</div>${C.docs.map(d=>`<button class="chip ${cites.includes(d.id)?'active':''}" onclick="toggleCite('${d.id}')">${cites.includes(d.id)?'✓ ':''}${esc(d.label)}</button>`).join('')}</div><div style="margin-top:10px;display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap"><button class="btn gold" onclick="submitWriting()">FILE WRITING</button><button class="btn ghost" onclick="S.showFrames=!S.showFrames;persist();render()">${S.showFrames?'HIDE':'SHOW'} FRAMES</button></div>${S.writing[ch]?'<div class="chip active" style="margin-top:10px">WRITING FILED ✓</div>':''}`;}
function renderCountsOnly(){const chip=document.querySelector('.callout .chip'); if(chip){chip.textContent=wordCount(document.getElementById('writer').value)+' words';}}
function toggleCite(id){const ch=S.chapter; let arr=S.cites[ch]||[]; arr=arr.includes(id)?arr.filter(x=>x!==id):[...arr,id]; S.cites[ch]=arr;persist();render();}
function submitWriting(){const ch=S.chapter,W=GAME.chapters[ch].writing,text=S.draft[ch]||'',cites=S.cites[ch]||[]; let issues=[]; if(wordCount(text)<W.min)issues.push('add more detail to reach the minimum word count'); if(cites.length<2)issues.push('cite at least two written sources'); for(const [lab,pat] of W.required){if(!(new RegExp(pat,'i')).test(text))issues.push('show '+lab);} if(issues.length){toast('Revision needed: '+issues.join('; '));return;} S.writing[ch]=text;persist();currentTab='decide';render();toast('Writing filed. The decision is now open.');}
function decideHTML(){const ch=S.chapter,C=GAME.chapters[ch],g=chapterGate(ch); if(!g.writing)return `<div class="callout"><div class="eyebrow">LOCKED</div><p>File the chapter writing first. Decisions are based on evidence, not guesses.</p></div>`; if(S.decisions[ch])return `<div class="callout"><div class="eyebrow">DECISION RECORDED ✓</div><h3>${esc(C.choice.prompt)}</h3><p>${esc(GAME.consequences[ch][S.decisions[ch]])}</p>${ch<3?'<button class="btn gold" onclick="advanceChapter()">CONTINUE STORY →</button>':'<button class="btn gold" onclick="finishStory()">VIEW ENDING →</button>'}</div>`; return `<div class="callout"><div class="eyebrow">CONSEQUENTIAL CHOICE</div><h3>${esc(C.choice.prompt)}</h3><p>Visible stakes: public trust, evidence quality, and future access will change based on what you decide.</p></div>${C.choice.options.map(o=>`<button class="dialogueOption" onclick="makeDecision('${o.id}')">${esc(o.text)}</button>`).join('')}`;}
function makeDecision(id){const ch=S.chapter; if(S.decisions[ch])return; const opt=GAME.chapters[ch].choice.options.find(o=>o.id===id); if(!opt)return; S.decisions[ch]=id; statChange(GAME.choiceEffects[ch][id]||{}); logEvent('Decision / '+opt.text+' → '+GAME.consequences[ch][id]); persist();render();openModal(`<div class="eyebrow">CONSEQUENCE</div><h3>${esc(opt.text)}</h3><p>${esc(GAME.consequences[ch][id])}</p><p class="soft">This consequence will carry into the rest of the case.</p>`,opt.text);}
function advanceChapter(){if(S.chapter>=3)return finishStory(); S.unlockedChapter=Math.max(S.unlockedChapter,S.chapter+1); S.chapter+=1; S.currentScene=GAME.entryScenes[S.chapter]; const sc=GAME.scenes[S.currentScene]; S.mapPos={x:sc.mapX,y:sc.mapY}; S.visited[sc.id]=true; S.view='map'; currentTab='objective';persist();closeModal();render();toast('New chapter unlocked. Continue on the map.');}
function endingName(){if(GAME.id==='town'){const a=S.stats; return a.trust>=61&&a.evidence>=61?'THE PEOPLE’S TOWN':a.safety<40?'THE BEAUTIFUL FLOOD':a.evidence<35?'THE PERFECT FALSE REPORT':'THE UNFINISHED REPAIR';} const a=S.stats; return a.credibility>=62&&a.alarm<50?'THE VERIFIED BROADCAST':a.alarm>=68?'THE RUMOR THAT ESCAPED':a.privacy<39?'THE COST OF A NAME':'THE CAUTIOUS CORRECTION';}
function endingText(){const id=endingName(); if(GAME.id==='town')return {'THE PEOPLE’S TOWN':'At dawn, workers and residents examine the repair plans together. The final record names the work that was done, the people who benefit, and the problems still unsolved.','THE BEAUTIFUL FLOOD':'The town celebrates the polished photographs, but water enters the lower streets. Your report shows where safety evidence was missed.','THE PERFECT FALSE REPORT':'HELIX displays 100% satisfaction. Residents read your evidence and ask why a perfect report was allowed to stand.','THE UNFINISHED REPAIR':'The town does not become perfect. It becomes more honest. Some residents disagree with your choices, and your report preserves those concerns.'}[id]; return {'THE VERIFIED BROADCAST':'Your correction is transmitted with the original record, its limits, and the evidence that changed the claim.','THE RUMOR THAT ESCAPED':'An unsupported story spreads before the facts can catch it. The archive now preserves a warning about confident claims made too soon.','THE COST OF A NAME':'The error is corrected, but an unnecessary accusation has harmed someone. The final record shows why fairness and accuracy are connected.','THE CAUTIOUS CORRECTION':'You do not have every answer. You publish what is supported, protect what is unverified, and leave careful questions for the next investigator.'}[id];}
function finishStory(){S.finished=true;persist(); const sc=GAME.scenes[GAME.scenes.length-1]; document.getElementById('app').innerHTML=`<header><div class="brand"><div class="eyebrow">CASE CLOSED</div><h1>${esc(GAME.title)}</h1><p>${esc(endingName())}</p></div><div class="toptools"><button class="btn slim ghost" onclick="reopenStory()">REVISIT MAP</button><button class="btn slim gold" onclick="exportReport()">EXPORT REPORT</button><button class="btn slim danger" onclick="resetGame()">START FRESH</button></div></header><main style="max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;padding:24px"><div class="panel" style="overflow:hidden"><div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:0;min-height:560px"><div style="padding:26px"><div class="eyebrow">FINAL OUTCOME</div><h1 style="font-size:2.3rem">${esc(endingName())}</h1><p style="font-size:1.05rem">${esc(endingText())}</p><div style="margin-top:14px">${Object.entries(GAME.statLabels).map(([k,v])=>`<div class="chip">${esc(v)}: ${S.stats[k]}</div>`).join('')}</div><div class="callout" style="margin-top:18px"><h3>Your chapter choices</h3>${GAME.chapters.map((ch,i)=>`<p><b>CH ${pad(i)}:</b> ${esc(GAME.consequences[i][S.decisions[i]]||'No decision recorded')}</p>`).join('')}</div></div><div style="position:relative;min-height:560px"><div class="sceneBg" style="background-image:url('${asset(sc.art)}');position:absolute;inset:0"></div><div class="fog"></div><div class="vignette"></div></div></div></div></main>`; syncAudio(); stopMapAnim();}
function reopenStory(){S.finished=false;S.view='map';persist();render();}
function logEvent(t){S.logs.push(new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], {hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'})+' · '+t); if(S.logs.length>120)S.logs=S.logs.slice(-120);persist();}
function logHTML(){const rows=(S.logs.length?S.logs:['No entries yet.']).slice().reverse().map(x=>`<div class="entry"><p>${esc(x)}</p></div>`).join(''); return `<div class="callout"><div class="eyebrow">INVESTIGATION LOG</div><p>Every clue, witness choice, and major action is recorded here.</p></div><div class="list">${rows}</div>`;}
function switchView(v){S.view=v;persist();render();}
function goNode(i){if(!sceneUnlocked(i))return; S.dest=i; persist(); if(S.view!=='map'){S.view='map';render();} startMapAnim();}
function travelToScene(i){S.currentScene=i;S.view='scene';S.visited[GAME.scenes[i].id]=true;persist();render();}
function jumpToChapter(ch){S.chapter=ch;const i=GAME.entryScenes[ch];S.currentScene=i;S.dest=i;S.view='map';persist();render();}
function enterCurrent(){S.view='scene';S.visited[currentSceneObj().id]=true;persist();render();}
function stepMap(){if(S.view!=='map')return; cancelAnimationFrame(anim); if(S.dest==null)return; const t=GAME.scenes[S.dest]; let dx=t.mapX-S.mapPos.x, dy=t.mapY-S.mapPos.y, dist=Math.hypot(dx,dy); if(dist<0.55){S.mapPos={x:t.mapX,y:t.mapY}; S.currentScene=S.dest; S.visited[t.id]=true; S.dest=(S.route&&S.route.length?S.route.shift():null); persist(); render(); if(S.dest==null)toast('Arrived at '+t.name); return;} const step=Math.min(.9,dist); S.mapPos.x+=dx/dist*step; S.mapPos.y+=dy/dist*step; const av=document.getElementById('avatar'); if(av){av.style.left=S.mapPos.x+'%'; av.style.top=S.mapPos.y+'%';} anim=requestAnimationFrame(stepMap);}
function startMapAnim(){if(S.dest!=null){cancelAnimationFrame(anim); anim=requestAnimationFrame(stepMap);}}
function stopMapAnim(){cancelAnimationFrame(anim);}
function openHotspot(id){const sc=currentSceneObj(); const h=sc.hotspots.find(x=>x.id===id); if(!h)return; if(h.kind==='document')openDocument(sc.chapter,h.id); else if(h.kind==='clue')openClue(S.currentScene); else openNpc(S.currentScene);}
function openDocument(ch,id){const d=GAME.chapters[ch].docs.find(x=>x.id===id); if(!d)return; S.docs[docKey(ch,id)]=true; persist(); logEvent('Document opened / '+d.label); openModal(`<div class="paper"><div class="eyebrow" style="color:#556">${esc(String(d.format).toUpperCase())}</div><h3>${esc(d.headline)}</h3><div class="meta"><span>${esc(d.kind)}</span><span>${esc(d.date)}</span><span>${esc(d.author)}</span></div><ul>${d.lines.map(line=>`<li>${esc(line)}</li>`).join('')}</ul><p><b>Evidence takeaway:</b> ${esc(d.takeaway)}</p></div>`,d.label); render();}
function openClue(sceneIndex){const sc=GAME.scenes[sceneIndex]; S.clues[sc.id]=true; persist(); logEvent('Field clue inspected / '+sc.name); const focus=sc.hotspots.find(h=>h.kind==='clue')||{x:50,y:50,label:'Field clue'}; openModal(`<div class="eyebrow">MOTION CLUE PANEL</div><h3>${esc(focus.label)}</h3><div class="clipFrame"><div class="clipBg" style="background-image:url('${asset(sc.art)}')"></div><div class="clipOverlay"></div><div class="focusDot" style="left:${focus.x}%;top:${focus.y}%"></div></div><div class="callout" style="margin-top:12px"><p>${esc(sc.clue)}</p><p class="soft">Use this animated evidence together with the written sources. It gives context, but it does not replace citation.</p></div>`,focus.label); render();}
function openNpc(sceneIndex){const sc=GAME.scenes[sceneIndex], chosen=S.npcChoices[sc.id]; let body=`<div class="eyebrow">WITNESS INTERVIEW</div><h3>${esc(sc.npc)}</h3><div class="callout"><p>${esc(sc.npcLine)}</p></div>`; if(chosen!==undefined){const opt=sc.npcOptions[chosen]; body+=`<div class="entry"><h4>Recorded choice</h4><p><b>You asked:</b> ${esc(opt.text)}</p><p><b>Result:</b> ${esc(opt.reply)}</p></div>`; openModal(body,sc.npc); return;} body+=sc.npcOptions.map((o,idx)=>`<button class="dialogueOption" onclick="chooseNpc(${sceneIndex},${idx})">${esc(o.text)}</button>`).join(''); openModal(body,sc.npc);}
function chooseNpc(sceneIndex,idx){const sc=GAME.scenes[sceneIndex], opt=sc.npcOptions[idx]; S.npcChoices[sc.id]=idx; statChange(opt.delta||{}); persist(); logEvent('Witness choice / '+sc.npc+' / '+opt.text); openModal(`<div class="eyebrow">WITNESS RESULT</div><h3>${esc(sc.npc)}</h3><p><b>You asked:</b> ${esc(opt.text)}</p><p>${esc(opt.reply)}</p><p class="soft">This changed the case conditions and may affect your ending.</p>`,sc.npc); render();}
function openModal(body,title='Investigation'){document.getElementById('modal').classList.add('open'); document.getElementById('modalHead').innerHTML=`<div><div class="eyebrow">INTERACTIVE EVIDENCE</div><h3>${esc(title)}</h3></div><button class="btn slim ghost" onclick="closeModal()">CLOSE</button>`; document.getElementById('modalBody').innerHTML=body;}
function closeModal(){document.getElementById('modal').classList.remove('open');}
function syncAudio(){const a=document.getElementById('amb'); if(!a)return; a.volume=.27; if(S.music)a.play().catch(()=>{}); else a.pause();}
function toggleMusic(){S.music=!S.music;persist();syncAudio();render();}
function download(name,txt,mime='text/plain;charset=utf-8'){const a=document.createElement('a'); const b=new Blob([txt],{type:mime}); a.href=URL.createObjectURL(b); a.download=name; document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove(); setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href),4000);}
function exportReport(){let out=[GAME.title,'ENDING: '+endingName(),'']; for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(GAME.statLabels))out.push(v+': '+S.stats[k]); out.push(''); GAME.chapters.forEach((ch,i)=>{out.push('=== CHAPTER '+pad(i)+' '+ch.name+' ==='); out.push('Decision: '+(ch.choice.options.find(o=>o.id===S.decisions[i])?.text||'—')); out.push('Consequence: '+(GAME.consequences[i][S.decisions[i]]||'—')); out.push('Cited sources: '+((S.cites[i]||[]).map(id=>GAME.chapters[i].docs.find(d=>d.id===id)?.label||id).join(' | '))); out.push('Writing:'); out.push(S.writing[i]||S.draft[i]||'[not written]'); out.push('');}); out.push('INVESTIGATION LOG'); out.push(...S.logs); download(GAME.id+'_reimagined_report.txt',out.join('\n'));}
function saveFile(){download(GAME.id+'_reimagined_save.json',JSON.stringify(S,null,2),'application/json');}
function loadFile(){const input=document.createElement('input'); input.type='file'; input.accept='.json,application/json'; input.onchange=()=>{const f=input.files&&input.files[0]; if(!f)return; f.text().then(t=>{try{const x=JSON.parse(t); S=Object.assign(initialState(),x); persist(); render(); toast('Save imported.');}catch(e){alert('Could not import this save.');}})}; input.click();}
function resetGame(){if(!confirm('Start again from the beginning?'))return; try{localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY)}catch(e){} S=initialState(); currentTab='objective'; closeModal(); render();}
window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')closeModal(); if(S.view==='map'&&e.key==='Enter')enterCurrent();});
// WORLD ATLAS / THE VISUAL EVIDENCE REBUILD
// All imagery and media are embedded before distribution; no remote service is used at runtime.
const EVIDENCE = [["VOICEPRINT A", "MATCH?", "SOURCE MISSING", "The waveform resembles a voice-identification sample, but the original source file is absent.", "The voice proves who spoke.", "The voice match might be artificial; the source cannot yet be verified.", "The analyst definitely forged the recording.", "verified 已核实的 • waveform 波形"], ["BADGE READ", "02:14", "EDIT 02:16", "The badge entered at 02:14 and the access-log entry was edited at 02:16.", "Noor must have personally edited the record.", "The record was edited after the entry; the editor is not yet proven.", "The guard could not have entered the building.", "access log 门禁记录 • claim 声称"], ["CAMERA FRAME", "02:16", "DOOR 02:14", "The paused camera timestamp is two minutes ahead of the door clock. The analyst has not determined why.", "The camera clock must be accurate and the door clock wrong.", "The clocks disagree by two minutes; a technical cause is possible but unconfirmed.", "The discrepancy proves deliberate deception.", "discrepancy 差异 • might 可能"], ["PHOTO METADATA", "THURSDAY", "FRIDAY POST", "The original image metadata indicates Thursday; a viral caption says Friday.", "The photograph proves a Friday event occurred.", "The caption may be misleading because it conflicts with the original metadata.", "The photographer must have changed the weather.", "metadata 元数据 • authentic 真实的"], ["EDIT HISTORY", "VERSION B", "CAPTION SWAP", "Two versions use the same images, but their captions make different claims.", "The second caption is automatically true.", "Changing a caption can change a claim even when the images stay the same.", "All viewers knowingly accepted falsehoods.", "editing 编辑 • credibility 可信度"], ["ACTIVITY LOG", "2 SHOWS", "3 PAGES", "Records support two broadcasts, three website pages, and help with 120 donated books.", "The applicant managed every school broadcast.", "A precise résumé should state the verified contributions and their limits.", "The contribution log proves the applicant did nothing.", "contribution 贡献 • résumé 简历"], ["GROUP LEDGER", "SHARED", "MULTIPLE NAMES", "The original project ledger credits several people rather than one individual.", "One student completed all the work alone.", "The record supports a shared contribution, not sole ownership.", "The group contributed nothing.", "collaboration 合作 • exaggeration 夸大"], ["BUS NOTICE", "03:30", "04:30 DRAFT", "The official notice says 3:30 at the north gate; the draft announcement says 4:30.", "The incorrect time cannot affect students.", "The announcement should be corrected using the official 3:30 time.", "The presenter must have intentionally lied.", "correction 更正 • official 官方的"], ["ETHICS BOARD", "FACT", "KINDNESS", "A small compliment and a wrong bus departure time have different practical consequences.", "All kindness requires hiding inconvenient facts.", "Helpful feedback can be kind, while a safety-critical time must be corrected.", "Every mistake should be treated as deliberate lying.", "ethical 伦理的 • consequence 后果"], ["TRANSMITTER", "VERIFY", "SEND?", "The transmitter can publish a supported correction or repeat an inaccurate message.", "It is safest to transmit every rumor immediately.", "A final correction should identify the verified facts and remaining uncertainty.", "Deleting all records proves the message was true.", "certainty 确定性 • evidence 证据"]];
const LOC_LORE = ["The recording booth smells of burnt plastic. A tape reel is turning with no one inside, and your own voice is printed beneath an unsigned transcript.", "The reception camera watches the entrance from two angles. A badge reader is glowing, but its last modification happened after the entry.", "Along the glass corridor, monitors update a fraction of a second apart. The camera and door clocks disagree, and the analyst refuses to guess which is correct.", "A photograph was copied and shared thousands of times. The original camera file was saved before the event described in the viral caption.", "Two identical screens show the same picture with different headlines. The editing timeline has been left open for someone to compare.", "The interview desk holds a résumé with three bold achievements. A smaller contribution log is attached beneath it with much more precise numbers.", "The applicants office is deserted except for folders and a collaborative project ledger. One name has been printed larger than all the others.", "A public announcement is ready to broadcast. One is a gentle compliment; the other could cause students to miss a bus.", "Wind strikes the transmitter roof. Two versions of the final message are waiting in the system, and only one can be transmitted."];
const LOC_THREATS = {};

function evidenceScene(id) { return GAME.scenes[id]; }
function evidenceProp(id, slot) { return asset(`${GAME.id}_ex${String(id).padStart(2,'0')}_${slot}.webp`); }
function evidenceState(sc){
 S.evidenceSeen=S.evidenceSeen||{};
 S.evidenceActive=S.evidenceActive||{};
 const id=sc.id;
 if(!Array.isArray(S.evidenceSeen[id])) S.evidenceSeen[id]=[];
 return S.evidenceSeen[id];
}
function evidenceTags(id){
 const arr=EVIDENCE[id];
 return arr[7].split(' • ').map(x=>{const bits=x.split(' ');return `<span class="lexToken"><b>${esc(bits.slice(0,-1).join(' '))}</b><span>${esc(bits.slice(-1)[0])}</span></span>`}).join('');
}
function sceneStats(st){ return Object.entries(st).map(([k,v])=>`<span class="miniMeter"><span>${esc(GAME.statLabels[k]||k)}</span><b>${v}</b></span>`).join('');}
const NPC_PORTRAITS=['voice_npc_0.png','voice_npc_1.png','voice_npc_2.png','voice_npc_3.png','voice_npc_4.png','voice_npc_5.png','voice_npc_6.png','voice_npc_7.png','voice_npc_8.png','voice_npc_9.png'];
function npcPortrait(index,name){const f=NPC_PORTRAITS[index]; return `<img class="portraitDraw photoPortrait" src="${asset(f)}" alt="${esc(name)} portrait" onerror="this.outerHTML=iconPortrait(${index})">`;}
function iconPortrait(index){
 const hues=['#b6d4c5','#d8afac','#c2c9e7','#e6cfac','#9ebcce','#c7cfbe','#f0c7a2','#c4b7dd','#a7d2ca','#c9d2a7'];
 const c=hues[index%hues.length];
 const hair=[`<path d="M25 45 Q19 12 57 11 Q87 17 76 49"/>`,`<path d="M22 42 Q23 6 61 16 Q91 15 76 53"/>`,`<path d="M24 40 Q18 19 42 12 Q74 9 79 34"/>`][index%3];
 return `<svg class="portraitDraw" viewBox="0 0 100 116" aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M7 113 Q6 83 27 77 L41 73 L61 74 Q89 78 93 113Z" fill="#31444d"/><path d="M38 72 L41 88 L57 88 L62 73Z" fill="${c}"/><ellipse cx="50" cy="47" rx="27" ry="32" fill="${c}"/><path d="${hair.match(/d="([^"]+)/)?.[1]||''}" fill="none" stroke="#17242c" stroke-width="14" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="40" cy="48" r="2" fill="#22333b"/><circle cx="60" cy="48" r="2" fill="#22333b"/><path d="M42 63 Q50 67 58 62" stroke="#7a6f68" fill="none" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M27 89 L43 109 L56 109 L74 89" fill="none" stroke="${c}" stroke-width="2"/></svg>`;
}
function liveReadout(index){
 const e=EVIDENCE[index];
 const id=evidenceScene(index).id;
 const extra=GAME.id==='voice' && index===2 ? `<div class="liveTiming"><span>CAMERA <b class="digitPulse">02:16</b></span><i>+ 02:00</i><span>DOOR <b class="digitPulse delayed">02:14</b></span></div>`:
 GAME.id==='town' && index===1 ? `<div class="liveTiming"><span>GATE <b>65 cm</b></span><i>− 10 cm</i><span>CHAIR <b>75 cm</b></span></div>`:
 `<div class="liveTiming"><span>FIELD <b class="digitPulse">${esc(e[1])}</b></span><i class="linePulse">◆</i><span>REFERENCE <b>${esc(e[2])}</b></span></div>`;
 return `<div class="measurementFeed"><div class="signalTop"><span>◉ LIVE MEASUREMENT</span><span class="ledLight"></span></div>${extra}<div class="tinyCaption">READ THE DIFFERENCE. A RECORDED VALUE DOES NOT IDENTIFY WHO CHANGED IT.</div></div>`;
}

function evidenceItem(sceneIndex,idx){
 const E=EVIDENCE[sceneIndex],sc=evidenceScene(sceneIndex),seen=evidenceState(sc).includes(idx),active=(S.evidenceActive||{})[sc.id]===idx;
 const labels=['01 · ORIGINAL VIEW','02 · DEVICE CLOSE-UP','03 · ARCHIVED RECORD'];
 return `<button class="exhibitTile ${seen?'examined':''} ${active?'chosen':''}" onclick="inspectExhibit(${sceneIndex},${idx})" aria-label="Examine ${esc(labels[idx])}"><div class="tilePhoto"><img src="${evidenceProp(sceneIndex,idx)}" alt="${esc(labels[idx]+' — '+E[0])}"><div class="tileSweep"></div><span class="tileNumber">${labels[idx]}</span><span class="tileStatus">${seen?'✓ INSPECTED':'◉ INSPECT'}</span></div><div class="tileDesc">${esc(idx===0?sc.name:idx===1?E[0]:E[2])}</div></button>`;
}
function inspectExhibit(sceneIndex,slot){
 const sc=evidenceScene(sceneIndex),seen=evidenceState(sc);
 if(!seen.includes(slot)){seen.push(slot);logEvent(`Exhibit ${slot+1} inspected / ${sc.name}`);}
 S.evidenceActive[sc.id]=slot;
 persist(); showEvidence(sceneIndex);
}
function findingOptions(sceneIndex){
 const E=EVIDENCE[sceneIndex],sc=evidenceScene(sceneIndex);
 const seen=evidenceState(sc);
 if(S.clues[sc.id])return `<div class="evidenceVerified"><div class="eyebrow">FINDING VERIFIED · CASE FILE UPDATED</div><h3>Evidence preserved</h3><p>${esc(E[5])}</p><p class="evidenceSmall">This is a supported observation, not proof of every possible explanation.</p><button class="btn gold" onclick="closeModal();currentTab='archive';render()">OPEN EVIDENCE BOARD →</button></div>`;
 if(seen.length<3)return `<div class="evidenceLocked"><span class="lockGlyph">⌕</span><div><b>VERIFYING EVIDENCE</b><p>Inspect all three objects before you choose what the evidence supports. <strong>${seen.length}/3 examined</strong>.</p></div></div>`;
 const options=[E[4],E[5],E[6]];
 const rotations=[[1,2,0],[2,0,1],[0,1,2]];
 const order=rotations[sceneIndex%3];
 return `<div class="findingControls"><div class="eyebrow">WRITE THE CASE RECORD</div><h3>Which statement is supported?</h3><p>Choose the claim you could defend using the exhibits. Be careful with words such as <i>must</i>, <i>might</i>, and <i>every</i>.</p>${order.map(q=>`<button class="analysisOption" onclick="verifyFinding(${sceneIndex},${q})"><span class="pickHalo">○</span> ${esc(options[q])}</button>`).join('')}</div>`;
}
function verifyFinding(sceneIndex,choice){
 const sc=evidenceScene(sceneIndex),E=EVIDENCE[sceneIndex];
 if(evidenceState(sc).length<3)return;
 if(choice===1){
    if(!S.clues[sc.id]){
      S.clues[sc.id]=true;
      const key=GAME.id==='town'?'evidence':'credibility';
      statChange({[key]:4});
      logEvent('Verified field finding / '+E[5]);
    }
    showEvidence(sceneIndex);
    toast('Finding preserved. A verified clue can now support your chapter report.');
 }else{
    S.evidenceMistakes=S.evidenceMistakes||{};
    S.evidenceMistakes[sc.id]=(S.evidenceMistakes[sc.id]||0)+1;
    if(S.evidenceMistakes[sc.id]===1)statChange(GAME.id==='town'?{evidence:-2}:{credibility:-2});
    persist();
    const msg=(choice===0?'This makes a claim that the sources do not support.':'This treats an assumption as fact.');
    const p=document.getElementById('evidenceFeedback');if(p){p.textContent=msg+' Re-read the record and try again.';p.hidden=false;}
    toast('Claim not supported. Re-examine the evidence.');
 }
}
function showEvidence(sceneIndex){
 const sc=evidenceScene(sceneIndex),E=EVIDENCE[sceneIndex],seen=evidenceState(sc),active=(S.evidenceActive||{})[sc.id]??0;
 const stage=`<div class="cinemaPhoto"><img src="${evidenceProp(sceneIndex,active)}" alt="${esc(E[0])} visual evidence"><div class="cinemaSweep"></div><div class="camOverlay">${active===0?`<span class="liveDot">● REC · ${String(sceneIndex+1).padStart(2,'0')}/A</span><span>CAMERA FEED / ${esc(sc.name)}</span>`:active===1?`<span class="liveDot">● DEVICE ON</span><span>PHYSICAL READOUT</span>`:`<span class="liveDot">■ ARCHIVE COPY</span><span>DOCUMENT SCAN</span>`}</div></div>`;
 const left=`<div class="cinemaStage"><div class="stripEyebrow"><span>VISUAL EVIDENCE FILE · ${esc(sc.name.toUpperCase())}</span><span class="statusLamp">● SECURED IMAGE</span></div>${stage}<div class="reelFooter"><span>LOOK CAREFULLY · COMPARE THE THREE EXHIBITS</span><span class="playLine"><i></i></span></div></div><div class="exhibitRail">${[0,1,2].map(j=>evidenceItem(sceneIndex,j)).join('')}</div>`;
 const detail=`<div class="interpretCard"><div class="eyebrow">INVESTIGATOR'S NOTE</div><h3>${esc(E[0])}</h3><p>${esc(sc.clue)}</p><div class="evidenceSmall">${active===0?'The location image provides context. A picture alone may not prove the cause.':active===1?`The display reads “${esc(E[1])}.” Compare it with “${esc(E[2])}.”`:'The archival copy preserves the exact claim. Check its wording against the image and device.'}</div><div class="lexRow">${evidenceTags(sceneIndex)}</div></div>`;
 const body=`<div class="evidenceUniverse" style="--evidence-bg:url('${asset(sc.art)}')"><div class="evidenceTopline"><span class="eyebrow">CASE FILE / FIELD INVESTIGATION</span><span>${seen.length}/3 EXHIBITS INSPECTED</span></div><div class="evidenceGrid"><div>${left}</div><div>${detail}<div class="interpretArea" id="findingArea">${findingOptions(sceneIndex)}<div id="evidenceFeedback" class="evidenceWarning" hidden></div></div></div></div><div class="caseFooter"><span>${esc(LOC_LORE[sceneIndex])}</span><button class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">RETURN TO LOCATION</button></div></div>`;
 openModal(body,E[0]);
}
openClue=function(sceneIndex){showEvidence(sceneIndex);};
function missionArt(index){const sc=evidenceScene(index);return `<img src="${asset(sc.art)}" alt="${esc(sc.name)}"/>`;}
function showWitness(sceneIndex){
 const sc=evidenceScene(sceneIndex), E=EVIDENCE[sceneIndex],chosen=S.npcChoices[sc.id];
 const portrait=npcPortrait(sceneIndex,sc.npc);
 const main=`<div class="witnessScene" style="background-image:url('${asset(sc.art)}')"><div class="witnessVignette"></div><div class="characterFrame">${portrait}<div><div class="eyebrow">IDENTIFIED CONTACT</div><h2>${esc(sc.npc)}</h2><p>${esc(sc.name)}</p></div></div><div class="witnessSignal"><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i></div></div>`;
 const testimony=`<div class="testimonyCard"><div class="eyebrow">RECORDED TESTIMONY</div><blockquote>“${esc(sc.npcLine)}”</blockquote><p>${esc(LOC_LORE[sceneIndex])}</p></div>`;
 const caption=`<div class="witnessProps"><div class="eyebrow">OBJECTS CONNECTED TO THIS CLAIM</div><div>${[0,1,2].map(j=>`<button onclick="openClue(${sceneIndex})" title="Examine physical evidence"><img src="${evidenceProp(sceneIndex,j)}" alt="Related evidence prop ${j+1}"><span>${['FIELD VIEW','DEVICE','RECORD'][j]}</span></button>`).join('')}</div></div>`;
 let choices='';
 if(chosen===undefined){
 choices=`<div class="witnessChoices"><div class="eyebrow">YOUR NEXT QUESTION MATTERS</div><p>Choose carefully. }

const originalGoNode=goNode;
goNode=function(i){
 if(!sceneUnlocked(i))return;
 // Walk along streets and corridors in graph order rather than teleporting across the environment.
 const queue=[[S.currentScene]],target=i;let route=null;
 while(queue.length){const path=queue.shift(),last=path[path.length-1];if(last===target){route=path;break;}
 for(const edge of MAPCFG.edges){if(!edge.includes(last))continue;const next=edge[0]===last?edge[1]:edge[0];if(path.includes(next)||queue.some(q=>q.includes(next))||!sceneUnlocked(next))continue;queue.push([...path,next]);}}
 if(route&&route.length>1){S.route=route.slice(2); S.dest=route[1];persist();if(S.view!=='map'){S.view='map';render();}startMapAnim();}
 else originalGoNode(i);
};

Which details are measurements, observations, opinions, or unverified claims? You will need two cited sources for your writing.</p><button class="btn gold" onclick="fileDocument(${ch},'${id}')">✓ ADD TO MY CASE FILE</button></div></div></div><div class="caseFooter"><span>KEEP READING: Do not assume the source proves more than its words support.</span><button class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">RETURN TO LOCATION</button></div></div>`;

function fileDocument(ch,id){

 if(!d)return;
 if(!S.docs[docKey(ch,id)]){S.docs[docKey(ch,id)]=true;logEvent('Primary written source filed / '+d.label);persist();}
 closeModal();render();toast('Source added to your case file.');
}

 return `<div class="callout"><div class="eyebrow">READING / CASE FILE ${pad(ch)}</div><p>Read the original texts, compare their reliability, and cite two sources in your written response. /* ORIGINAL OFFLINE SOUND DESIGN — no online services, external URLs or speech. */
(function installAudioDefaults(){
 if (typeof S.effects!=='boolean') S.effects=false;
 if (typeof S.musicVolume!=='number') S.musicVolume=70;
 if (typeof S.effectsVolume!=='number') S.effectsVolume=58;
})();
const SOUND_ENGINE={base:null,tension:null,effects:{},lastFx:{},fade:null};
function bootAudio(){
 if(SOUND_ENGINE.base)return;
 const h=document.getElementById('audioHost')||document.body;
 for(const type of ['base','tension']){
   const a=document.createElement('audio');
   a.id='sound-'+type;
   a.loop=true;
   a.preload='auto';
   a.setAttribute('playsinline','');
   a.src=asset(GAME.id+'_new_'+type+'.mp3');
   a.volume=0;
   h.appendChild(a);
   SOUND_ENGINE[type]=a;
 }
}
function audioDanger(){
 const high=GAME.id==='town' ? (S.stats.safety<47 || S.stats.trust<35): (S.stats.alarm>60 || S.stats.credibility<35);
 return S.chapter>=2 || high;
}
function applyMusicMix(ms=650){
 bootAudio();
 const base=SOUND_ENGINE.base, tense=SOUND_ENGINE.tension;
 const strength=S.music ? Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(S.musicVolume??70)/100))*.90 : 0;
 const high=audioDanger();
 const targets=[strength*(high?.23:1),strength*(high?.89:0)];
 if(S.music){
   for(const a of [base,tense]){
      if(a.paused) a.play().catch(()=>{});
   }
 }
 if(SOUND_ENGINE.fade!==null){cancelAnimationFrame(SOUND_ENGINE.fade);SOUND_ENGINE.fade=null;}
 const orig=[base.volume,tense.volume],start=performance.now();
 function tick(now){
   const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(now-start)/ms)),k=t*t*(3-2*t);
   base.volume=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,orig[0]+(targets[0]-orig[0])*k));
   tense.volume=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,orig[1]+(targets[1]-orig[1])*k));
   if(t<1){SOUND_ENGINE.fade=requestAnimationFrame(tick)}
   else {SOUND_ENGINE.fade=null; if(!S.music){base.pause();tense.pause();}}
 }
 SOUND_ENGINE.fade=requestAnimationFrame(tick);
}
/* Persistent audio host: redrawing game UI must never restart music. */
syncAudio=function(){
 if(!S.music&&!SOUND_ENGINE.base)return;
 applyMusicMix(650);
};
function playFx(name,force=false){
 if(!force && !S.effects)return;
 const now=performance.now(),limit=name==='footstep'?250:90;
 if((now-(SOUND_ENGINE.lastFx[name]||0))<limit)return;
 SOUND_ENGINE.lastFx[name]=now;
 const file=GAME.id+'_new_'+name+'.mp3';
 if(!SOUND_ENGINE.effects[name]){
   const a=new Audio(asset(file));
   a.preload='auto';
   SOUND_ENGINE.effects[name]=[a,a.cloneNode(true)];
 }
 const pool=SOUND_ENGINE.effects[name],a=pool.find(t=>t.paused)||pool[0];
 try{a.pause();a.currentTime=0;}catch(e){}
 a.volume=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(S.effectsVolume??58)/100))*.82;
 a.play().catch(()=>{});
}
function setSoundEnabled(type,what){
 if(type==='music')S.music=!!what;
 else if(type==='effects')S.effects=!!what;
 persist();
 if(type==='music')applyMusicMix();
 if(type==='effects' && S.effects)playFx('witness');
 render();openAudioPanel();
}
function enableAllSound(){
 S.music=true;S.effects=true;persist();
 applyMusicMix();playFx('witness');
 render();openAudioPanel();
}
function muteAllSound(){S.music=false;S.effects=false;persist();applyMusicMix();render();openAudioPanel();}
function setSoundVolume(type,val){
 const v=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,Number(val)||0));
 if(type==='music'){S.musicVolume=v;applyMusicMix(220);}
 else S.effectsVolume=v;
 persist();
 const target=document.getElementById('level-'+type);
 if(target)target.textContent=v+'%';
}
function openAudioPanel(){
 const mv=S.musicVolume??70,ev=S.effectsVolume??58;
 const html=`<div class="audioSettings">
   <div class="audioHeading">ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK · ${GAME.id==='town'?'RIVERMERE AFTER DARK':'AURORA SIGNAL ROOM'}</div>
   <p class="audioDescription">Sound is completely optional. The story, clues and English tasks remain fully readable when muted. There are no voices or spoken instructions.</p>
   <div class="audioTiles">
     <div class="audioTile"><div class="audioTileTop"><div><div class="eyebrow">ATMOSPHERE</div><h3>${GAME.id==='town'?'Wind, bells & uneasy chords':'Machinery, tapes & distant tones'}</h3></div><button class="btn slim ${S.music?'gold':'ghost'}" aria-pressed="${!!S.music}" onclick="setSoundEnabled('music',${S.music?'false':'true'})">${S.music?'MUSIC ON':'MUSIC OFF'}</button></div>
       <label for="musicSlider">Ambience volume <strong id="level-music">${mv}%</strong></label>
       <input aria-label="Ambience volume" id="musicSlider" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="${mv}" oninput="setSoundVolume('music',this.value)">
       <div class="audioTrackInfo">Music shifts to a more tense layer as the mystery develops.</div></div>
     <div class="audioTile"><div class="audioTileTop"><div><div class="eyebrow">INTERACTIONS</div><h3>Physical clues & subtle game feedback</h3></div><button class="btn slim ${S.effects?'gold':'ghost'}" aria-pressed="${!!S.effects}" onclick="setSoundEnabled('effects',${S.effects?'false':'true'})">${S.effects?'EFFECTS ON':'EFFECTS OFF'}</button></div>
       <label for="effectsSlider">Effect volume <strong id="level-effects">${ev}%</strong></label>
       <input aria-label="Sound effects volume" id="effectsSlider" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="${ev}" oninput="setSoundVolume('effects',this.value)">
       <button class="btn ghost slim" style="margin-top:10px" onclick="playFx('clue',true)">PREVIEW A CLUE SOUND</button>
       <div class="audioTrackInfo">Soft footsteps, paper, doors, clues, puzzle locks and decision stings. No jump scares.</div></div>
   </div>
   <div class="audioActions"><button class="btn gold" onclick="enableAllSound()">ENABLE MUSIC + EFFECTS</button><button class="btn ghost" onclick="muteAllSound()">MUTE EVERYTHING</button><button class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">RETURN TO GAME</button></div>
   <p class="audioFootnote">Both channels start OFF in a new game. Your sound choices are saved in this browser; no internet or login is required.</p>
  </div>`;
 openModal(html,'SOUND & ATMOSPHERE');
}
toggleMusic=function(){openAudioPanel();};
/* Only consequential interactions receive sound cues: avoid noise on every UI click. */
function wrapCue(name,cue,judge){
 const original=window[name];
 if(typeof original!=='function')return;
 window[name]=function(...args){
   const prev=judge?.before?.(...args);
   const result=original.apply(this,args);
   const sound=judge?.after?judge.after(prev,...args):cue;
   if(sound)playFx(sound);
   return result;
 };
}
wrapCue('goNode','footstep');
wrapCue('enterCurrent','door');
wrapCue('travelToScene','footstep');
wrapCue('openDocument','paper');
wrapCue('openClue','clue');
wrapCue('openNpc','witness');
wrapCue('inspectExhibit','exhibit');
wrapCue('chooseNpc','decision');
wrapCue('verifyFinding',null,{before:(i)=>!!S.clues[GAME.scenes[i].id],after:(before,i,choice)=>choice===1 ? (before?'ui':'success'):'error'});
wrapCue('unlockCode',null,{before:()=>!!S.microOpen[S.chapter],after:(before)=>S.microOpen[S.chapter]&&!before?'success':'error'});
wrapCue('checkPuzzle',null,{before:()=>!!S.puzzleSolved[S.chapter],after:(before)=>S.puzzleSolved[S.chapter]&&!before?'success':'error'});
wrapCue('submitWriting',null,{before:()=>!!S.writing[S.chapter],after:(before)=>S.writing[S.chapter]&&!before?'paper':'error'});
wrapCue('makeDecision','decision');
wrapCue('advanceChapter','chapter');
wrapCue('finishStory','ending');
/* Save settings on reload and release resources when tab hidden. */
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{
 if(!SOUND_ENGINE.base)return;
 if(document.hidden){for(const a of [SOUND_ENGINE.base,SOUND_ENGINE.tension])a.pause();}
 else if(S.music){applyMusicMix(450);}
});
document.addEventListener('pointerdown',()=>{
 if(S.music&&(!SOUND_ENGINE.base||SOUND_ENGINE.base.paused))applyMusicMix(250);
},{passive:true});
const soundWrappedRender=render;
render=function(){soundWrappedRender();};

render();

</script>
<script>
/* === DO NOT ANSWER YOUR OWN VOICE: FINAL-DRAFT CASE SYSTEM ===

const V_FINAL_DRAFT_VERSION='5.0-review';
function vVerified(ch){return !!S.puzzleState['v_verified_'+ch];}
const V_TOOLS=[
 {label:'ACCESS RECORD FORENSICS',question:'Which conclusion can the verified access record support?',options:[
  ['The record was edited at 02:16, but the editor is not established.',1],
  ['The badge name proves that Noor altered the log.',0],

 {label:'ORIGINAL PHOTO CHECK',question:'Which evidence should control the public caption?',options:[
  ['Friday’s viral caption; the stage looks the same.',0],

 {label:'CONTRIBUTION VERIFICATION',question:'Which claim matches the applicant’s actual contribution?',options:[

 {label:'EMERGENCY ANNOUNCEMENT ROUTING',question:'Which message should be issued to protect students?',options:[

];

function vVerify(ch){const pick=S.puzzleState['v_pick_'+ch], t=V_TOOLS[ch];if(pick===undefined){toast('Choose an evidence-supported conclusion first.');return;}
 if(t.options[pick][1]){S.puzzleState['v_verified_'+ch]=true;persist();render();toast('Source checked. The field code can now be entered.');}
 else{toast('The evidence does not prove that statement. Compare the primary sources and try again.');}}
function vInterventionHTML(ch){const t=V_TOOLS[ch],pick=S.puzzleState['v_pick_'+ch],okay=vVerified(ch);
 let vis=ch===0?'<div class="v-waveform" aria-hidden="true"></div>':ch===1?'<div class="v-proofCard"><small>STAGE_1430.JPG / ORIGINAL FILE</small>DATE: THURSDAY · 15:00<br>STATUS: UNEDITED<br>PUBLIC CAPTION: FRIDAY NIGHT</div>':ch===2?'<div class="v-proofCard"><small>ACTIVITY REFERENCE SHEET</small>RADIO: 2 broadcasts<br>WEB: 3 template pages<br>BOOKS: 120 collected by the class</div>':'<div class="v-proofCard"><small>OFFICIAL RETURN NOTICE</small>DEPARTURE: 3:30 P.M.<br>LOCATION: NORTH GATE<br>ARRIVE TEN MINUTES EARLY</div>';
 return `<div class="${['v-tapeDeck','v-timeline','v-resume','v-broadcast'][ch]}"><div class="v-deckTop"><span>CASE 0${ch+1} / ${esc(t.label)}</span><span><i class="v-led ${okay?'verified':''}"></i> ${okay?'SOURCE VERIFIED':'VERIFICATION PENDING'}</span></div>${vis}<p class="v-brief">${esc(t.question)}</p><div class="v-consoleBtns">${t.options.map((o,i)=>`<button class="pickBtn ${pick===i?'active':''}" onclick="vPick(${ch},${i})">${esc(o[0])}</button>`).join('')}</div><div class="v-stamp">${okay?'<b>VERIFIED:</b> '+esc(t.explain):'Use the original documents. Displayed names, popularity and intentions are not enough to prove a claim.'}</div><button class="btn ${okay?'ghost':'gold'}" style="margin-top:10px" onclick="vVerify(${ch})">${okay?'RECHECK CONCLUSION':'VERIFY WITH SOURCES'}</button></div>`;
}
const vOldGateHTML=gateHTML;
gateHTML=function(){return `<div class="callout"><div class="sectionSeal">FIELD INSTRUMENT</div><h3>${esc(V_TOOLS[S.chapter].label)}</h3><p>Check the claim against original evidence before unlocking the case record. This is not a timed quiz.</p></div>${vInterventionHTML(S.chapter)}<div class="callout" style="margin-top:12px"><div class="eyebrow">EVIDENCE CODE</div>${vOldGateHTML()}</div>`;};
const vOldUnlockCode=unlockCode;
unlockCode=function(){if(!vVerified(S.chapter)){toast('Verify your evidence conclusion before entering the field code.');return;}return vOldUnlockCode();};

const V_BRANCH=[
 [
  {title:'ACCESS-LOG COPY PRESERVED',kind:'Archive duplicate',text:'Two versions of the access record survive. The edit time is documented, but the editor is not identified. Preserve the original and the changed record together.'},
  {title:'WITNESS INTERVIEWS KEPT SEPARATE',kind:'Interview log',text:'Noor and Ben gave separate accounts. A name on a badge record does not prove who used it. Further verification is still needed.'},
  {title:'PUBLIC ACCUSATION: ACCESS LIMITED',kind:'Security memo',text:'Noor was accused online before the editor was verified. The private archive was restricted. A future investigator must distinguish suspicion from proof.'}
 ],
 [
  {title:'CORRECTED PHOTO CAPTION',kind:'Public archive',text:'A correction now links to the verified original file. The image shows Thursday rehearsal; its caption had incorrectly named Friday.'},
  {title:'DELETED POST: UNRESOLVED RUMOURS',kind:'Platform log',text:'The public post was removed without explanation. The original caption spread further in screenshots. Readers are asking why the post disappeared.'},
  {title:'EDITOR ACCUSED WITHOUT PROOF',kind:'Complaints file',text:'The publication implied the writer intended to deceive, but available records verify only the image date, not the writer’s motive.'}
 ],
 [
  {title:'CANDIDATE CONTRIBUTIONS VERIFIED',kind:'Recruitment file',text:'The candidate has been offered a fair review based on two radio broadcasts, three template-based pages, and helping the class collect books.'},
  {title:'APPLICANT REJECTED FOR ALL CONTRIBUTIONS',kind:'Recruitment file',text:'Exaggerations were rejected, but the applicant’s actual demonstrated skills were also ignored. The record shows why proportional judgment matters.'},
  {title:'RÉSUMÉ WARNING STILL OPEN',kind:'Verification alert',text:'The impressive original résumé passed an early screen. The verification record still contradicts several claims.'}
 ]
];
function vPreviousBranch(){const ch=S.chapter;if(ch===0)return null;const ids=[['checklog','question','accuse'],['edit','delete','blame'],['accurate','reject','stretched']]; const prior=S.decisions[ch-1];const ix=ids[ch-1].indexOf(prior);return ix<0?null:{...V_BRANCH[ch-1][ix],key:ch+'_'+prior};}
function vBranchHTML(){const b=vPreviousBranch();if(!b)return '';return `<div class="v-return"><div class="eyebrow">RETURNING RECORD · PAST DECISION</div><h4>${esc(b.title)}</h4><p>Earlier choices changed what this case can now access.</p><button class="btn slim ${S.puzzleState['v_return_'+b.key]?'gold':'ghost'}" onclick="vReadBranch()">${S.puzzleState['v_return_'+b.key]?'REVIEW RETURNING RECORD':'OPEN RETURNING RECORD'}</button></div>`;}
function vReadBranch(){const b=vPreviousBranch();if(!b)return;S.puzzleState['v_return_'+b.key]=true;persist();openModal(`<div class="docSheet"><div class="eyebrow" style="color:#556">${esc(b.kind.toUpperCase())}</div><h3>${esc(b.title)}</h3><p>${esc(b.text)}</p></div><div class="sideNote" style="margin-top:12px"><p>Compare this record with the original evidence. The consequences of the earlier decision have become part of the later investigation.</p></div>`,'RETURNING CASE RECORD');render();}

const vOldObjectiveHTML=objectiveHTML;
objectiveHTML=function(){return `${vBranchHTML()}${vOldObjectiveHTML()}`;};
const vOldArchiveHTML=archiveHTML;
archiveHTML=function(){return `${vBranchHTML()}${vOldArchiveHTML()}`;};

/* Replace general radio/photograph/resume/ethics forms with individual investigative work surfaces. */
const vOldPuzzleHTML=puzzleHTML;
puzzleHTML=function(){const ch=S.chapter, P=GAME.chapters[ch].puzzle, g=chapterGate(ch);
 if(!g.micro||S.puzzleSolved[ch])return vOldPuzzleHTML();ensurePuzzleState(ch);
 const submit=`<div style="margin-top:12px"><button class="btn gold" onclick="checkPuzzle()">${['FILE CERTAINTY RECORD','RESTORE EVENT TIMELINE','VERIFY THE RÉSUMÉ','ISSUE ETHICAL REVIEW'][ch]}</button></div>`;
 if(ch===0)return `<div class="v-tapeDeck"><div class="v-deckTop"><span>ROOM 214 / EVIDENCE THRESHOLD</span><span>DO NOT INFER IDENTITIES</span></div><h3>${esc(P.title)}</h3><p class="v-brief">${esc(P.instruction)}</p><div class="v-waveform" aria-hidden="true"></div>${P.items.map((it,i)=>`<div class="sortCard" style="margin-top:10px"><div class="meta">OBSERVATION ${i+1}</div><h4>${esc(it[0])}</h4><div class="v-consoleBtns">${P.options.map(o=>`<button class="pickBtn ${(S.puzzleState[ch][i]||'')===o?'active':''}" onclick="vAnswer(${ch},${i},${JSON.stringify(o).replace(/'/g,'&#39;')})">${esc(o)}</button>`).join('')}</div></div>`).join('')}${submit}</div>`;
 if(ch===1){const st=S.puzzleState[ch];return `<div class="v-timeline"><div class="v-deckTop"><span>PHOTO VAULT / CHRONOLOGY</span><span>ORIGINAL DATES FIRST</span></div><h3>${esc(P.title)}</h3><p class="v-brief">${esc(P.instruction)}</p><div class="briefGrid"><div class="sortCard"><h4>Verified sequence</h4><div class="manualSlots">${st.picked.map((x,i)=>`<div class="picked"><span><b>${i+1}.</b> ${esc(x)}</span><button class="btn slim ghost" onclick="removeStep(${ch},${i})">remove</button></div>`).join('')||'<p class="soft">No events placed.</p>'}</div></div><div class="sortCard"><h4>Unordered records</h4><div class="stepPool">${st.pool.map((x,i)=>`<button class="pickBtn" onclick="addStep(${ch},${i})">${esc(x)}</button>`).join('')}</div><button class="btn slim ghost" style="margin-top:10px" onclick="resetOrder(${ch})">RESTART SEQUENCE</button></div></div>${submit}</div>`;}
 if(ch===2)return `<div class="v-resume"><div class="v-deckTop"><span>PERSONNEL / VERIFIED CONTRIBUTIONS</span><span>NO CREDIT WITHOUT RECORD</span></div><h3>${esc(P.title)}</h3><p class="v-brief">${esc(P.instruction)}</p>${P.items.map((it,i)=>`<div class="sortCard" style="margin-top:12px"><div class="meta">RÉSUMÉ ENTRY / ${esc(it[0])}</div><div class="v-consoleBtns">${it[1].map(o=>`<button class="pickBtn ${(S.puzzleState[ch][i]||'')===o?'active':''}" onclick="vAnswer(${ch},${i},${JSON.stringify(o).replace(/'/g,'&#39;')})">${esc(o)}</button>`).join('')}</div></div>`).join('')}${submit}</div>`;
 return `<div class="v-broadcast"><div class="v-deckTop"><span>ETHICAL EDITOR / LIVE ALERT</span><span>DEPARTURE: 3:30 P.M.</span></div><h3>${esc(P.title)}</h3><p class="v-brief">${esc(P.instruction)}</p>${P.items.map((it,i)=>`<div class="sortCard" style="margin-top:12px"><div class="meta">EDITOR CASE ${i+1}</div><h4>${esc(it[0])}</h4><div class="v-consoleBtns">${it[1].map(o=>`<button class="pickBtn ${(S.puzzleState[ch][i]||'')===o?'active':''}" onclick="vAnswer(${ch},${i},${JSON.stringify(o).replace(/'/g,'&#39;')})">${esc(o)}</button>`).join('')}</div></div>`).join('')}${submit}</div>`;
};
function vAnswer(ch,i,val){setPuzzleValue(ch,i,val);render();}

/* Writing desk with live checks, without destroying focus. */
const vOldWriteHTML=writeHTML;
writeHTML=function(){let html=vOldWriteHTML();return html.replace(/oninput="S\.draft\[\d+\]=this\.value;persist\(\);renderCountsOnly\(\)"/g, 'oninput="S.draft['+S.chapter+']=this.value;persist();vUpdateWriting()"');};
function vUpdateWriting(){const el=document.getElementById('writer');if(!el)return;S.draft[S.chapter]=el.value;persist();const count=document.querySelector('.callout .chip');if(count)count.textContent=wordCount(el.value)+' words';}

const vOldRenderScene=renderScene;
renderScene=function(){const html=vOldRenderScene();const ch=GAME.scenes[S.currentScene].chapter;const b=vPreviousBranch();const status=vVerified(ch)?V_TOOLS[ch].label+' / VERIFIED':V_TOOLS[ch].label+' / PENDING';return html+`<div class="v-sceneState">${esc(status)}</div>`;};
const vOldMakeDecision=makeDecision;
makeDecision=function(id){vOldMakeDecision(id);persist();};

/* Optionally show Chinese glosses at point of need. */
function vTerms(ch){return [
 [['evidence','证据'],['deception','欺骗'],['might have','可能已经'],['must have','一定已经']],
 [['verified','已核实'],['unedited','未经编辑'],['rehearsal','排练'],['caption','图片说明']],
 [['stretch the truth','夸大事实'],['accurate','准确的'],['proof','证据'],['résumé','简历']],
 [['white lie','善意的谎言'],['pro-social','亲社会的'],['antisocial','反社会的'],['official notice','官方通知']]
 ][ch];}
const vOldGateVer=gateHTML;
gateHTML=function(){let raw=vOldGateVer();return raw+`<div class="callout"><div class="eyebrow">VOCABULARY / 中文支持</div><div class="kv">${vTerms(S.chapter).map(([en,zh])=>`<span>${esc(en)} · ${esc(zh)}</span>`).join('')}</div></div>`;};

render();
</script><script>

(function(){

const rooms={
  town:[

    {name:'Garden entrance',kind:'garden',glows:[[.104,.335,.13,'warm',.29],[.586,.328,.14,'warm',.31],[.55,.81,.18,'warm',.08]],water:[[.50,.88,.42,.12,.21]],leaf:[.5,.10,.90,.26],mist:[.60,.58,.035],motes:12},
    {name:'Riverbank flood',kind:'river',glows:[[.13,.62,.16,'warm',.23],[.19,.72,.13,'red',.20],[.84,.46,.10,'warm',.13]],water:[[.50,.73,.56,.23,.32]],rain:[[.01,.10,.99,.90,.25]],mist:[.65,.51,.07],motes:8},
    {name:'Archive lamp',kind:'archive',glows:[[.54,.30,.20,'warm',.28],[.83,.53,.10,'blue',.10]],rain:[[.76,.02,.98,.63,.17]],mist:[.72,.38,.035],motes:24},
    {name:'Pump enclosure',kind:'pump',glows:[[.66,.48,.18,'blue',.20],[.77,.31,.14,'warm',.12]],water:[[.54,.86,.35,.12,.18]],mist:[.39,.62,.055],motes:13},
    {name:'Workshop',kind:'workshop',glows:[[.68,.44,.18,'blue',.17],[.29,.22,.13,'warm',.10]],screen:[[.34,.33,.23,.11,'blue',.11]],mist:[.5,.58,.025],motes:20},
    {name:'Relay station',kind:'relay',glows:[[.36,.41,.24,'blue',.13],[.78,.24,.19,'blue',.13]],screen:[[.45,.21,.24,.22,'blue',.17]],mist:[.44,.57,.023],motes:14},
    {name:'Council chamber',kind:'council',glows:[[.56,.44,.23,'warm',.18],[.32,.26,.10,'blue',.09]],screen:[[.54,.43,.30,.16,'blue',.12]],mist:[.5,.45,.027],motes:19},
    {name:'Control hall',kind:'core',glows:[[.40,.42,.28,'blue',.17],[.70,.67,.17,'blue',.11]],screen:[[.35,.39,.25,.18,'blue',.13]],mist:[.6,.43,.04],motes:12},
    {name:'Final overlook',kind:'overlook',glows:[[.41,.47,.15,'blue',.15],[.82,.45,.12,'warm',.13]],screen:[[.42,.47,.27,.24,'blue',.18]],mist:[.62,.38,.06],motes:16}
  ],
  voice:[
    {name:'Interview booth',kind:'booth',glows:[[.22,.14,.17,'warm',.21],[.89,.13,.12,'red',.31],[.76,.38,.14,'blue',.18]],screen:[[.76,.40,.20,.19,'blue',.26]],rain:[[.42,.08,.75,.38,.14]],mist:[.6,.44,.022],motes:8},
    {name:'Reception',kind:'reception',glows:[[.08,.12,.15,'warm',.22],[.37,.40,.17,'blue',.21]],screen:[[.38,.42,.15,.15,'blue',.20]],rain:[[.73,.03,.98,.58,.20]],mist:[.65,.47,.033],motes:16},
    {name:'Corridor',kind:'corridor',glows:[[.77,.38,.12,'red',.28],[.38,.70,.16,'warm',.16]],rain:[[.01,.06,.41,.72,.23]],water:[[.47,.86,.43,.10,.14]],mist:[.58,.62,.08],motes:11},
    {name:'Vault',kind:'vault',glows:[[.30,.34,.29,'blue',.20],[.80,.41,.12,'warm',.16]],screen:[[.35,.72,.32,.12,'warm',.13]],rain:[[.05,.12,.45,.69,.15]],mist:[.42,.47,.07],motes:14},
    {name:'Editing suite',kind:'editing',glows:[[.34,.43,.27,'blue',.24],[.59,.17,.20,'red',.09]],screen:[[.27,.42,.32,.24,'blue',.18]],mist:[.4,.46,.018],motes:9},
    {name:'Interview',kind:'interview',glows:[[.43,.30,.25,'blue',.12],[.62,.24,.13,'warm',.13]],screen:[[.42,.33,.27,.13,'blue',.12]],mist:[.5,.50,.023],motes:8},
    {name:'Applicants',kind:'applicants',glows:[[.25,.55,.17,'blue',.17],[.61,.30,.14,'warm',.10]],screen:[[.27,.50,.25,.20,'blue',.15]],mist:[.5,.50,.017],motes:8},
    {name:'Newsroom',kind:'newsroom',glows:[[.46,.32,.18,'blue',.17],[.69,.66,.18,'red',.13]],screen:[[.42,.28,.24,.17,'blue',.18]],mist:[.5,.40,.029],motes:11},
    {name:'Ethics committee',kind:'ethics',glows:[[.25,.38,.23,'blue',.19],[.53,.46,.12,'warm',.08]],screen:[[.21,.65,.31,.13,'warm',.14]],rain:[[.01,.10,.40,.53,.17]],mist:[.38,.54,.037],motes:15},
    {name:'Transmission roof',kind:'roof',glows:[[.80,.18,.12,'red',.28],[.28,.64,.18,'blue',.10]],rain:[[0,0,1,1,.44]],mist:[.66,.60,.10],motes:6}
  ]
};
const palette={warm:[255,180,89],blue:[107,204,239],red:[250,74,88]};
const reduced=window.matchMedia&&window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
let raf=0,can=null,ctx=null,vp=null,ro=null,img=null,room=null,last=0,ticks=0,particles=[],rain=[],on=false;
let scale=1,offX=0,offY=0,drawW=0,drawH=0,dt=0;
const game=typeof GAME!=='undefined'?GAME.id:'town';
const rand=(a,b)=>a+Math.random()*(b-a);
const enabled=()=>S.sceneMotion===undefined?!Boolean(reduced&&reduced.matches):!!S.sceneMotion;
const sourceCoord=(x,y)=>[offX+x*drawW,offY+y*drawH];
function fadeLight(x,y,r,color,opacity){const [xx,yy]=sourceCoord(x,y);const rad=r*drawW;
 const col=palette[color]||palette.blue, g=ctx.createRadialGradient(xx,yy,0,xx,yy,rad);
 g.addColorStop(0,`rgba(${col.join(',')},${Math.min(.55,opacity)})`);g.addColorStop(.12,`rgba(${col.join(',')},${opacity*.36})`);g.addColorStop(.52,`rgba(${col.join(',')},${opacity*.10})`);g.addColorStop(1,`rgba(${col.join(',')},0)`);
 ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(xx-rad,yy-rad,rad*2,rad*2);
}
function resize(){if(!can||!vp)return;const b=vp.getBoundingClientRect(),dpr=Math.min(1.45,window.devicePixelRatio||1);
 const W=Math.max(1,Math.round(b.width)),H=Math.max(1,Math.round(b.height));
 can.width=Math.round(W*dpr);can.height=Math.round(H*dpr);can.style.width=W+'px';can.style.height=H+'px';
 ctx=can.getContext('2d',{alpha:true});ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
 const iw=img&&img.naturalWidth||1536,ih=img&&img.naturalHeight||864;
 scale=Math.max(W/iw,H/ih)*1.018; drawW=iw*scale;drawH=ih*scale;offX=(W-drawW)/2;offY=(H-drawH)/2;
}
function reseed(){particles=Array.from({length:room.motes||12},(_,i)=>({x:Math.random(),y:Math.random(),speed:rand(.006,.019),alpha:rand(.07,.22),r:rand(.6,1.8),phase:rand(0,7)}));
 rain=[];for(const zone of room.rain||[]){const n=Math.max(6,Math.round(zone[4]*85)); for(let i=0;i<n;i++)rain.push({z:zone,x:rand(zone[0],zone[2]),y:rand(zone[1],zone[3]),speed:rand(.18,.34),length:rand(.008,.026),opacity:rand(.035,.13)});}}
function mist(now){if(!room.mist)return;const [cx,cy,str]=room.mist;const [x,y]=sourceCoord(cx+Math.sin(now*.08)*.035,cy+Math.cos(now*.11)*.011);const r=Math.max(drawW*.40,drawH*.30);
 const g=ctx.createRadialGradient(x,y,0,x,y,r);g.addColorStop(0,`rgba(170,214,225,${str*(.7+.25*Math.sin(now*.19))})`);g.addColorStop(.6,`rgba(168,212,220,${str*.2})`);g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(170,210,223,0)');ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(x-r,y-r,r*2,r*2);}
function lights(now){for(let i=0;i<(room.glows||[]).length;i++){let [x,y,r,color,str]=room.glows[i];let wave=.86+.08*Math.sin(now*(.7+i*.38)+i*2.1)+.06*Math.sin(now*(2.8+i*.5));
 if(game==='voice'&&(color==='red'||room.kind==='editing')&&Math.sin(now*.84+i*.8)>.985)wave*=.26;
 if(game==='town'&&room.kind==='garden'&&S.ng&&S.ng.actions&&S.ng.actions.gate)wave*=1.07;
 fadeLight(x,y,r,color,str*wave);}}
function water(now){for(const [x,y,rx,ry,str] of room.water||[]){const [cx,cy]=sourceCoord(x,y),rw=rx*drawW,rh=ry*drawH;
 ctx.save();ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(cx,cy,Math.abs(rw),Math.abs(rh),0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.clip();
 for(let i=0;i<18;i++){const yy=cy+Math.sin(i*2.1)*rh*.84,px=cx+Math.sin(i*1.7+now*.42)*rw*.67;
 const length=(.045+.034*Math.sin(now*.65+i*.47))*drawW;
 ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(px-length*.5,yy);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(px,yy+Math.sin(now*.9+i)*1.6,px+length*.55,yy);
 ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(187,226,232,${str*(.26+.20*Math.sin(now*.83+i*1.2))})`;ctx.lineWidth=.45+(i%3)*.27;ctx.stroke();}
 ctx.restore();}}
function rainStroke(now){for(const p of rain){let [x1,y1,x2,y2,str]=p.z;const zoneH=y2-y1;
 p.y+=dt*p.speed;if(p.y>y2+.025){p.y=y1-.01;p.x=rand(x1,x2)}
 const [x,y]=sourceCoord(p.x,p.y);const len=p.length*drawH;
 const drift=game==='voice'&&room.kind==='roof'?.24:.15;
 ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,y);ctx.lineTo(x-drift*len,y+len);ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(190,218,240,${p.opacity*(str+.37)})`;ctx.lineWidth=.55;ctx.stroke();}}
function motes(now){for(const p of particles){p.y-=dt*p.speed;p.x+=Math.sin(now*.24+p.phase)*dt*.002;
 if(p.y<-.05){p.y=1.05;p.x=Math.random()}const [x,y]=sourceCoord(p.x,p.y);let a=p.alpha*(.7+.25*Math.sin(now*.6+p.phase));
 ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,p.r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(${game==='town'?'244,228,186':'171,216,239'},${a})`;ctx.fill();}}
function screens(now){for(const [x,y,w,h,color,str] of room.screen||[]){const [xx,yy]=sourceCoord(x,y),ww=w*drawW,hh=h*drawH;
 const col=palette[color]||palette.blue;ctx.save();ctx.globalCompositeOperation='screen';
 // An almost invisible data heartbeat, anchored to an existing display in the photograph.
 for(let k=0;k<11;k++){let bar=xx+(k/10-.5)*ww;const amplitude=(Math.sin(now*1.2+k*.68)+1)*.5;
 ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(${col.join(',')},${str*(.19+.20*amplitude)})`;
 ctx.fillRect(bar, yy+(1-amplitude)*hh*.25, Math.max(1,ww*.007), Math.max(2,hh*(.08+amplitude*.33)));}
 ctx.restore();}}
function leaves(now){if(!room.leaf)return;const [xx,yy,ww,hh]=room.leaf;ctx.save();ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';for(let i=0;i<7;i++){
 const theta=now*(.28+i*.022)+i*1.8, x=xx+(i-3)*ww/8+Math.sin(theta)*.008, y=yy+Math.sin(i*1.55)*hh*.18;
 const [px,py]=sourceCoord(x,y);ctx.save();ctx.translate(px,py);ctx.rotate(.2*Math.sin(theta));
 ctx.fillStyle='rgba(5,36,17,.044)';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(0,0,drawW*.045,drawH*.019,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.restore();}ctx.restore();}
function loop(ms){if(!on||!can)return;raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
 if(document.hidden||document.querySelector('.modal.open'))return;
 if(ms-last<29)return;dt=Math.min(.055,(ms-last)/1000||.033);last=ms;ticks++;

 ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);ctx.save();ctx.globalCompositeOperation='screen';

}
function stop(){on=false;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);raf=0;if(ro)ro.disconnect();ro=null;if(can)can.remove();can=null;ctx=null;img=null;vp=null;}
function install(){stop();document.querySelectorAll('.ambient-toggle').forEach(n=>n.remove());
 document.body.classList.toggle('ambient-focus',S.view==='scene'&&!!S.sceneFocus);
 const buttons=document.querySelector('.toptools');if(buttons){const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='btn slim ghost ambient-toggle';b.type='button';b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(enabled()));b.setAttribute('aria-label','Toggle environmental animation. All clues remain visible when motion is off.');
 b.innerHTML=`<span class="ambient-indicator"></span>${enabled()?'MOTION ON':'MOTION OFF'}`;
 b.addEventListener('click',()=>{S.sceneMotion=!enabled();persist();render();});
 buttons.insertBefore(b,buttons.querySelector('.btn.danger'));
 const focus=document.createElement('button');focus.className='btn slim ghost ambient-focus-toggle';focus.type='button';focus.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(!!S.sceneFocus));focus.textContent=S.sceneFocus?'EXIT FOCUS':'FOCUS VIEW';focus.setAttribute('aria-label','Toggle full-scene presentation view');focus.addEventListener('click',()=>{S.sceneFocus=!S.sceneFocus;persist();render()});
 buttons.insertBefore(focus,buttons.querySelector('.btn.danger'));}

 if(!enabled()||S.view!=='scene')return;
 vp=document.querySelector('.viewport');const sc=GAME.scenes[S.currentScene];if(!vp||!sc)return;
 room=(rooms[game]||rooms.town)[S.currentScene];if(!room)return;
 can=document.createElement('canvas');can.className='ambient-film';can.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');can.setAttribute('role','presentation');
 const ref=vp.querySelector('.viewportTop');vp.insertBefore(can,ref);

 const still=vp.querySelector('.sceneBg');if(still){still.style.setProperty('--par-x','0px');still.style.setProperty('--par-y','0px');}
 img=new Image();img.onload=()=>{if(can){resize();}};img.src=asset(sc.art);
 ro=new ResizeObserver(()=>{if(can)resize()});ro.observe(vp);resize();reseed();on=true;last=performance.now();raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
